name: almanac
description: Local-only heatmaps and streaks for how you actually work: days, languages, repositories and hours, tracked honestly.

commands.title: Almanac: Why am I idle right now?
Almanac: Set the client for this repository
Almanac: Export my data to JSON

almanac.enabled.description: Track activity. Turn off to stop recording entirely; data already recorded is kept until you delete it.

almanac.idleMinutes.markdownDescription:
How long the clock keeps running after the last sign of activity. Anything you do in VS Code counts as a sign: typing, scrolling, a terminal command, a debug step, switching tabs. The window must also be **focused**, so the clock stops when you switch to another app.

This also bounds machine evidence: output from a running command can carry the clock for twice this value past your last real interaction, and never starts one on its own.

almanac.countTerminal.markdownDescription: Count working in the integrated terminal. Includes output arriving from a running command, so a long test run or a coding-agent session reads as work rather than as idle time. Turn it off and terminal interaction stops counting entirely rather than being recorded under another name.

almanac.countDebug.description: Count stepping through a debug session as activity.

almanac.trackProjects.markdownDescription: Record which repository you worked in. Almanac stores the **repository folder name** and the path of the folder you opened relative to the repository root, so a monorepo subfolder rolls up under its repository. Never the absolute path, never file names.

almanac.trackGitCommits.description: Count commits you authored in open repositories, read through VS Code's built-in Git extension.

almanac.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the current streak and today's active time in the status bar.

almanac.streak.minMinutes.description: Minutes of active work a day needs before it counts towards a streak.

almanac.retentionDays.description: How many days of history to keep. Older days are deleted.

almanac.clients.markdownDescription: Maps a repository name to the client it belongs to, so several repositories report as one client, e.g. `{ "thedevlabs-api": "thedevlabs" }`. Repositories with no entry report under their own name. Set it from **Almanac: Set the client for this repository**.

enumDescriptions: Round each day up to 15 minutes
Round each day up to 30 minutes

almanac.report.rounding.description: Rounding applied per client per day in reports. Raw time is always shown alongside.

steps.title: Nothing leaves this machine
steps.description:
